parameters.name: DatasourceId
parameters.description: Data source ID. Get this ID using the ListDatasources API.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: End time for query read/write volume. Format: yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. Get this ID using the ListInstances API.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Fuzzy filter for feature view names.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: Project ID. Get this ID using the ListProjects API.

parameters.name: ShowStorageUsage
parameters.description: Show storage usage. Default is true.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Start time for query read/write volume. Format: yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Feature view type.

- Batch - offline feature

- Stream - real-time feature

- Sequence - sequence feature

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description: Show detailed information. If set to false, do not show UsageStatistics for each view; show only the total. Default is true.
